text: Let me register you as a challenger. Your name is\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)], yes?

text: Great! Now, in order to face Gym Leader Katy,\nyou’ll first need to pass the Gym Test.

label: gym_mushi_010_receptionist_04
text: Here at the Cortondo Gym, that means taking\non the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Olive Roll[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: gym_mushi_010_receptionist_history
text: Olive production is a big part of life in Cortondo.\c\nWe’ve held the Olive Harvest Festival here each\nyear for generations to usher in bumper crops!

label: gym_mushi_010_receptionist_05
text:
To pass our Gym Test, you’ll need to roll an
olive-shaped ball all the way to the goal.\c
Your efforts should help ensure we get a great
olive harvest next year, too!

text: The staffer over at the olive-rolling field will\nexplain the rules to you in further detail.

label: gym_mushi_010_receptionist_map
text: I’ll register the location in your map app. It’s just\nto the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]north of town[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
